image_depicts: Modern multi-story campus building with lawn, benches, walkways and parking, red-roofed lower buildings behind, consistent with UCP's Palma de Cima (Lisbon HQ) campus which has a João Paulo II library tower and multiple faculty buildings.
notes: AUDIT_PASS_RIGHTS_UNKNOWN. Downloaded and viewed existing campus.webp: real professional photo of a modernist building complex, no logo/crest, no text. UCP has campuses in both Lisbon (Palma de Cima, the HQ) and Porto (Foz) plus Braga/Viseu; manifest says Lisbon. Confirmed via UCP's own site that Palma de Cima (Lisbon) is a multi-building campus with a distinctive library tower, architecturally consistent with this photo, but could not 100%-pin the exact building from the image alone (no signage). Reviewer should double-check this is Lisbon and not the Porto/Foz campus before treating as final.

image_depicts: Wide aerial photo of USP's Cidade Universitária Armando de Salles Oliveira campus in São Paulo, showing a distinctive round building and clock tower near the Praça do Relógio, university blocks, parking, tree-lined avenues, and the city skyline beyond.

Original license/source unknown.

canonical_name: Universidade Federal do Rio de Janeiro
image_depicts: Aerial view of a large neoclassical quadrangular white building with red-tile roofs surrounded by trees and palms, amid the Rio de Janeiro city skyline - matching the historic Palácio Universitário (former Hospício Pedro II) at UFRJ's Praia Vermelha campus.
notes: AUDIT_PASS_RIGHTS_UNKNOWN. Downloaded and viewed existing campus.webp: real aerial photo. Architecture (quadrangular neoclassical complex, symmetrical pavilions, red-tile roofs) and surrounding dense urban skyline strongly match the well-documented Palácio Universitário at UFRJ's Praia Vermelha campus (a heritage-listed former psychiatric hospital, now housing several UFRJ schools). Good confidence on identity. Original license/source unknown.

canonical_name: Universit degli Studi della Campania Luigi Vanvitelli
image_depicts: Palm-lined garden courtyard with a cream/yellow Italianate palazzo building with arcaded portico in the background, consistent with the grounds of the Reggia di Caserta (Royal Palace of Caserta), where the Vanvitelli University's rectorate/central offices are seated.
notes: AUDIT_PASS_RIGHTS_UNKNOWN, MODERATE CONFIDENCE. Downloaded and viewed existing campus.webp: real photo of a specific palazzo courtyard with tall palms, stylistically consistent with the Reggia di Caserta grounds where this university (named after the Reggia's architect Vanvitelli) has its legal seat, but no on-image text confirms it and web search did not turn up an exact matching reference photo. Reviewer should double-check this is actually the university's building and not merely tourist imagery of the Reggia unconnected to the university.

image_depicts: Classical Corinthian-columned portico of a University of Pavia building, with a Latin inscription on the pediment reading 'SOLLEMNIBVS STVDIORVM DICATVM ANNO MDCCCL' (dedicated to solemn studies, year 1850).
notes: AUDIT_PASS_RIGHTS_UNKNOWN. Downloaded and viewed existing campus.webp: real photo of a grand classical portico. The pediment's own carved Latin inscription explicitly dedicates the building 'to solemn studies' (1850), strong self-identifying evidence this is a university ceremonial building rather than an unrelated landmark; high confidence this is genuinely a University of Pavia building even without independently naming the exact hall. Original license/source unknown.
